seo.title: Odyssey | Premium automated cinematic memorial videos
seo.description: Odyssey is a premium platform for automated cinematic commemorative video creation to preserve, share, and honor memory.

contact.title: Write to us
contact.subtitle: Questions about a tribute, an ongoing project, or uncertainty before ordering? Tell us where you stand. We respond thoughtfully.

partnersPage.title: The Souvenir Sanctuary for your families
partnersPage.kicker: A new standard of remembrance for funeral homes
partnersPage.introProblem: Families want authentic celebrations but shy away from high-pressure commercial approaches. Your counselors have neither the time for video editing nor the appetite to push add-on sales.
partnersPage.introResolution: Odyssey resolves this paradox: we turn technology into a pure gesture of empathy.
partnersPage.promiseTitle: The promise: you offer, we create
partnersPage.promiseBody: Your counselors grant access to the Sanctuary in one click. The family invites their circle to contribute memories. Our cinematic engine weaves those fragments into a tribute film—automatically. Zero editing for them, zero effort for you.

growthEngineItems.title: Emotional viral acquisition
growthEngineItems.body: By inviting their circle to contribute, the family naturally exposes your brand to dozens of loved ones. It is the most dignified, organic visibility for your funeral home.

growthEngineItems.title: Integrated community funding
growthEngineItems.body: The extended circle can contribute financially to unlock premium formats, extended archives, or tangible keepsakes (commemorative books, physical copies). The financial burden leaves the immediate family and becomes a collective act of generosity.

growthEngineItems.title: Automatic shared revenue
growthEngineItems.body: Whenever the community enriches the tribute or orders a keepsake, your firm shares in the revenue generated. Everything is tracked in real time on your partner dashboard.

growthEngineItems.title: Post-ceremony retention (grief follow-up)
growthEngineItems.body: The relationship no longer ends on the day of the service. Automated commemorative communications (anniversary reminders, milestone dates) extend your firm's presence over months and years.

growthEngineItems.title: Zero friction
growthEngineItems.body: No software to install, no equipment to buy, no complex training.

partnersPage.demoIntro: In 30 minutes, discover the family's emotional journey on mobile, your future partner space, and the transparent mechanics of your commissions.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.body: Every life is a masterpiece that deserves its own cinema. Odyssey is not a tool; it is a visual sanctuary. In the noise of grief, we orchestrate silence, light, and memory to create an unbreakable bond. We don't just make videos; we restore the sovereign dignity of remembrance.
